Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Class FaceSearchFeatureEntry

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.search.FaceSearchFeatureEntry
public final class FaceSearchFeatureEntry extends java.lang.Object
A face feature awaiting storage. Use it for features received from a server, or for batch writes after calling extractFeatureBlocking() on images.
